story.fullStory:
Jesse Mccartney's "Shake" reached #54 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Shake" is the original lead single from American singer and actor Jesse McCartney's supposedly fourth studio album, Have It All.

The song peaked at #54 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 12 weeks on the chart.

Shake was released in 2010.

"Shake" is the original lead single from American singer and actor Jesse McCartney's supposedly fourth studio album, Have It All.
Have It All was, however, postponed to a point that it was eventually cancelled completely.
"Shake" is written by McCartney, Jacob Kasher Hindlin, and written and produced by Joshua Coleman.
